data.name: Wings
data.description: You gain batlike, birdlike, or insectlike functional wings, allowing you to fly as the Fly spell for %1 minutes per day. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments. You can select this discovery multiple times; each time you do so, you add your caster level to the number of minutes per day that you can fly with the wings. This flight is an extraordinary ability.|WingsDuration
